title: This week in the Time Patrol.
intro: Official raids and events, in short. Full details are at each official source.
updated_note: Checked 13 Nov 2026, Australia/Perth (UTC+8). Status badges are computed from starts_at / ends_at (and platform windows) in the visitor’s current time. Ended raids and events move to Past events automatically. Announcements with no end date stay visible.

items.title: Themed World Tournament: 「ドラゴンボール超限定一武道会」
items.summary: Official themed World Tournament (online ranked PvP), announced 13 November 2026 in Bandai's information post id1854. PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam: 14 Nov, 9:00 AM – 15 Nov, 9:00 PM Perth (UTC+8). Xbox: 14 Nov, 5:00 PM – 16 Nov, 5:00 AM Perth (UTC+8). Your rank is your total points from the Character and Themed World Tournament ranked matches during the event. Everyone who takes part gets 50 TP Medals; the top 50 also win TP and STP Medals, and the top 5 get a Street Name plus a full set of the 7 Dragon Balls. Enter via the World Tournament reception desk in Conton City; you need the Saiyan and Namek arcs cleared in Time Patrol, an online connection and a multiplayer lobby login. Leaving rooms straight after matching, or farming the same player, can lose you your rewards. Schedule and rewards may change without notice.

items.title: Final Festival — Week 2: Cross Versus
items.summary: The official Final Festival of Universes (Last World Tournament) is still underway (re-checked 12 November 2026 against the official Japanese information post). It started on 30 October 2026, after a free 10th-anniversary update on 27 October. This week’s Time Patrol game mode is Cross Versus (9–15 November). Raise camaraderie with Trunks, the Supreme Kai of Time or Fu to unlock special illustrations. A commemorative Gi and medal from the festival can unlock related items in Xenoverse 3 (2027) through Bandai Namco ID linkage. The official Japanese information post lists the in-game event through 15 February 2027, 8:59 AM JST (7:59 AM Perth), and states that the maximum Star Coins obtainable is about 25 times the previous tournament.

items.title: 10th anniversary login bonus
items.summary: A limited login bonus bundled with the 27 October free update (update #23) is still running (re-checked 12 November 2026 against the official Japanese information post). It ends on 16 November 2026 at 11:59 PM JST (10:59 PM Perth). Official rewards listed on the information post include loading-screen artwork, STP Medals and the Xenoverse 2 10th Anniversary celebration cake hat.

items.title: RAID: vs Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) (Lite)
items.summary: This official raid has ended (re-checked 12 November 2026 against the official information post id1853). The last platform window closed at 12 November, 2:00 PM Perth. PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam ran 5 Nov, 8:00 PM – 11 Nov, 10:00 PM PT (6 Nov, 12:00 PM – 12 Nov, 2:00 PM Perth, UTC+8). Xbox (official Japanese clock) ran 6 Nov, 4:00 AM – 12 Nov, 6:00 AM JST (6 Nov, 3:00 AM – 12 Nov, 5:00 AM Perth, UTC+8). Participation rewards were Hercule Badge (Common) ×1 and TP Medals ×50. Higher damage tiers also awarded more TP and STP medals, plus titles, costumes, accessories, artwork and Super Souls (see the official post). Entry was via the Time Rift (big blue hole) on the west side of the Shop Area.

items.title: 10th anniversary repost campaign: goal reached
items.summary: The official Xenoverse 2 10th anniversary repost campaign hit its goal of 1,010 reposts worldwide. Official Japanese and English Dragon Ball Games posts on 10 November 2026 say every Time Patroller will receive a special loading screen illustration of the Conton City regulars and their instructors. The campaign itself ended on 9 November 2026 at 2:59 PM UTC; this is the result announcement. No official end date was given for how long the illustration stays available.
items.source_label: Official Dragon Ball Games post on X (10 Nov 2026)

items.title: Free 10th anniversary update (Update #23)
items.summary: The official free 10th-anniversary update (Update #23) has been available since 27 October 2026. The official Japanese information post says it includes Final Festival of Universes content, 10th-anniversary accessories (including the celebration cake hat), new loading-screen artwork, and the login bonus that runs until 16 November 2026, 11:59 PM JST. The official English Dragon Ball Games account posted the 10th-anniversary trailer on 25 October 2026.

items.title: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 — the final Xenoverse 2 DLC
items.summary: Bandai Namco’s final post-launch DLC for Xenoverse 2. Officially includes playable Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled) and Supreme Kai of Time (Ultra Supervillain), Ultra Time Patrol Battles, and the Gallery of Time.

items.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 announced for 2027
items.summary: Unveiled at Dragon Ball Games Battle Hour 2026. Planned for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and PC (Steam) in 2027.
